# Digital Footprint Health Report · 数字足迹体检报告

> Upload your X/Twitter archive and generate a local privacy health report. Auto-detect tweets that leak phone numbers, emails, addresses, locations, and sensitive topics. Get a 0–100 privacy score with a risk list. Batch delete risky tweets on demand. **Your data never leaves your device** — all processing is 100% local browser-side.

## 1. Product Overview

Digital Footprint Health Report is a privacy protection tool that helps X (formerly Twitter) users:

1. **Download** their data archive from X
2. **Upload** it to a browser-based tool that parses everything locally
3. **Scan** for risky tweets containing phone numbers, email addresses, home addresses, location data, and sensitive topics
4. **Review** a 0–100 privacy health score with a categorized risk list
5. **Delete** risky tweets in batch via X's official write API (paid, per-tweet pricing)

The tool was built because most tweet-deletion services either:
- Upload your data to third-party servers (privacy risk)
- Only access the most recent 3,200 tweets (API limitation)
- Require OAuth permissions that read your entire account

Our approach: the X archive is parsed entirely in your browser. Nothing is uploaded. Only the deletion request itself touches X's API.

---

## 2. How It Works

### Step 1: Download Your X Archive
Go to X Settings → Your account → Download an archive of your data. X emails you a ZIP file (typically 24 hours).

### Step 2: Upload & Parse Locally
Upload the tweets.csv or tweets.js file from the ZIP. All parsing happens in-browser — no data sent to any server.

### Step 3: Generate Privacy Report
The tool auto-detects:
- Phone numbers
- Email addresses
- Physical addresses
- Location data (check-ins, coordinates)
- Sensitive topics (health, political, financial)
- Stale/old content

Results in a 0–100 health score with a six-dimension risk distribution chart.

### Step 4: Batch Delete (Optional)
Select detected tweets and confirm deletion. Pricing is transparent:
- Small tier: ≤1,000 tweets
- Medium tier: 1,001–10,000 tweets
- Large tier: >10,000 tweets (¥20 base + ¥0.15/tweet)

Pay via PayPal. Jobs can be paused, resumed, or cancelled anytime. Full refund before deletion starts; prorated refund while running.

---

## 4. Privacy & Security

**Core Design Principle:** Your data belongs to you. We collect as little as possible.

- **Archive processing:** 100% local browser-side. The uploaded file is never sent to our servers or any third party.
- **Storage:** Parsed data is stored encrypted in browser local storage. Decryption keys stay on your device.
- **Deletion:** Only the delete request touches X's official API — no reading of DMs, followers, or other private data.
- **Payment:** Handled by PayPal/Stripe — we never see your card details.
- **Analytics:** Google Analytics 4 for anonymous usage stats (page views, feature usage). Not personally identifiable.

See full [Privacy Policy](https://digital-footprint-health.shop/privacy) for details.

---

## 5. Pricing

Archive upload and health report generation are **free**.

Tweet deletion is charged per tweet, tiered by count:

| Tier | Tweet Count | Pricing |
|------|-------------|---------|
| Small | ≤1,000 | Per-tier rate |
| Medium | 1,001–10,000 | Per-tier rate |
| Large | >10,000 | ¥20 base + ¥0.15/tweet |

Refund policy:
- Before deletion starts: full refund
- During deletion: prorated by deleted count
- After completion: not refundable

---

## 6. FAQ Summary

Full FAQ page: https://digital-footprint-health.shop/faq

**Q: Is my data safe? Does it get uploaded to a server?**
A: Very safe. Archives are parsed 100% locally in your browser. Nothing is uploaded. Only deletion requests hit X's API.

**Q: How much does it cost?**
A: Upload and report generation are free. Deletion is per-tweet, tiered by volume. Pausable and refundable.

**Q: Can it delete ALL my old tweets?**
A: Yes. By uploading your X data archive (which contains every tweet since day one), we can reach tweets beyond the 3,200-post API limit.

**Q: How do I download my X archive?**
A: X Settings → Your data → Download archive. Takes ~24 hours.

**Q: What file formats are supported?**
A: tweets.csv and tweets.js (from the X data archive ZIP).

**Q: Can I recover deleted tweets?**
A: No, deletion is permanent. We recommend backing up your archive before deleting.

**Q: Will X ban me for bulk deleting?**
A: No. Our deletion respects API rate limits, mimicking normal user behavior.

**Q: Can I filter which tweets to delete?**
A: Yes. The system auto-detects risk types (phone, email, address, location, sensitive content). You can filter by risk type.

## 7. Blog Content

### How to Delete Old Tweets — 2026 Complete Guide
**URL:** /blog/how-to-delete-old-tweets-2026  
**Language:** Chinese  
**Content covers 5 methods:**

1. **Manual deletion** — Slow but private (~5 sec/tweet, 14 hours for 10k tweets)
2. **Third-party cloud services** (TweetDelete, Circleboom, TweetEraser) — Simple but uploads data to servers
3. **Browser extensions** (X Cleaner) — Safer than cloud, but limited to recent 3,200 tweets
4. **Archive + local processing** — Recommended. Full history, most secure, 100% local
5. **Custom Python script** — Full control, but requires X API ($100/month) and dev skills

Includes a comparison table and FAQ section.

---

## 8. Technical Stack

- **Framework:** Next.js 16 (App Router, React Server Components)
- **Backend:** Supabase (Auth + Database)
- **Deployment:** Vercel Edge Network
- **Payments:** Stripe (primary) + PayPal (secondary)
- **Data Processing:** Pure browser-side JavaScript (no Node.js backend for parsing)
- **Analytics:** Google Analytics 4
- **Auth:** Google OAuth
- **Rate Limiting:** Upstash Redis (optional) / in-memory fallback
- **Security:** Strict CSP, HSTS (max-age=63072000), X-Frame-Options DENY

### Key NPM Dependencies
- next: 16.x
- supabase: latest
- @stripe/stripe-js: latest
- @paypal/react-paypal-js: latest
